title: Bound on a frequency family
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, and assign to each $\omega\in\Omega$ a sign vector on $n$ coordinates. Suppose the resulting multiset of sign vectors is $k$-wise independent, in the sense that every nonempty Fourier coefficient of degree at most $k$ of its induced density is zero. If $\mathcal F$ is a family of coordinate subsets such that $|S\cup T|\leq k$ for every $S,T\in\mathcal F$, then $|\mathcal F|\leq|\Omega|$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nonempty set $\Omega$ and a sign vector assigned to each of its elements
A finite family $\mathcal F$ of coordinate subsets
Every union $S\cup T$ for $S,T\in\mathcal F$ has cardinality at most $k$
